title: Morning Routine Builder
learning_objectives: Learn the order of morning tasks

events.description: Good morning! It's time to get ready for school. What do you want to do first?

choices.label: Brush your teeth
choices.effect: Sparkly clean teeth! Great start to the day!

choices.label: Get dressed
choices.effect: You picked out a great outfit! Looking good!

events.description: One thing done! What's next on your morning routine?

choices.label: Eat breakfast
choices.effect: Yummy cereal! Now you have energy for the day!

choices.label: Pack your backpack
choices.effect: Your backpack is all ready to go!

events.description: Almost ready! One more thing before the bus comes!

choices.label: Put on your shoes
choices.effect: Shoes on and tied! You're ready to go!

choices.label: Give a goodbye hug
choices.effect: What a sweet goodbye! Have a great day!

recap_template: Today you built your very own morning routine! You practiced putting tasks in order to get ready for school.
positive_framing_rules: Never say the student picked the wrong order
Celebrate each completed task as progress
Frame all routines as equally good choices
ai_variation_allowed: Add fun descriptions of breakfast options
Add a pet greeting the student in the morning

title: Getting Ready Race
learning_objectives: Learn to pick what to do first
Understand that some tasks come before others

events.description: Oh! You just woke up and the school bus is coming soon! Let's figure out a plan. What should you do first?

choices.label: Get dressed quickly
choices.effect: Smart thinking! You got dressed right away!

choices.label: Eat a quick breakfast
choices.effect: An apple gives you energy! Good choice!

events.description: Great job! Now what's the next important thing?

choices.label: Grab your backpack
choices.effect: You remembered your backpack! All your homework is inside!

choices.label: Brush your teeth
choices.effect: Fresh and clean! Your smile is sparkling!

events.description: The bus is almost here! One last thing!

choices.label: Wave goodbye
choices.effect: You waved goodbye and ran to the bus! Made it!

choices.label: Double-check your bag
choices.effect: Everything is there! You're so organized!

recap_template: You figured out a great plan to get ready! You practiced picking what to do first when there's a lot to do.
positive_framing_rules: Never say the student is running out of time
Celebrate each step as a win
Frame the situation as an exciting adventure, not stressful
ai_variation_allowed: Add a silly pet following the student around

title: Bedtime Countdown
learning_objectives: Understand that routines help us feel ready

events.description: It's almost bedtime! You have time for 3 activities before you go to sleep. What do you want to do first?

choices.label: Take a warm bath
choices.effect: Splish splash! You feel warm and cozy!

choices.label: Read a story
choices.effect: What a fun story! Your imagination is amazing!

events.description: That was nice! What do you want to do next?

choices.label: Brush your teeth
choices.effect: Sparkly teeth! The tooth fairy would be proud!

choices.label: Put on pajamas
choices.effect: Your cozy pajamas feel so soft and warm!

events.description: One more thing before lights out!

choices.label: Pick a stuffed friend
choices.effect: Your stuffed friend is ready to sleep with you!

recap_template: You built a wonderful bedtime routine! Getting ready for bed in a good order helps you feel calm and cozy.
positive_framing_rules: Never mention staying up too late or being in trouble
Frame bedtime as a cozy, positive experience
Celebrate each step of the routine
ai_variation_allowed: Add descriptions of a favorite stuffed animal
Add a lullaby or calming description
